title: Service Details

fields.label: Full description
fields.name: full_description
fields.instructions: Shown at the top of the service page. When blank, the short description is used there.

fields.label: Highlights
fields.name: highlights
fields.instructions: One per line. Homepage cards show the first three.

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.name: deliverables
fields.instructions: One per line: Title | Note. The note is optional — without one, the deliverable shows the shared line from Pages → Services → Single Service Pages.

fields.label: Tools & platforms
fields.name: technologies
fields.instructions: One per line. Cards show the first three.

fields.label: About this section
fields.message:
Pricing for this service's page only. Leave it empty and the page shows the pricing from Pages → Services.

To give this service its own packages, fill in at least one plan: a plan needs a name and a monthly price.

fields.label: Highlighted words
fields.name: plans_highlight
fields.instructions: Part of the title above, shown in the blue gradient. Must match exactly.

fields.label: Plan 1
fields.name: plans_plan_1
fields.instructions: A plan needs a name and a monthly price. Clear either one to hide this plan.

fields.label: Help button label
fields.name: plans_help_button
fields.instructions: Opens the Book a Discovery Call form. Blank hides the button.

fields.label: Browser title
fields.name: seo_title
fields.instructions: The browser tab title for this service page. Blank uses the service name followed by " | Adlogix Agency".

description: The post title is the service name. Its detail page is /services/<slug>.

title: Show on

fields.label: Show this entry on
fields.name: display_on
fields.instructions: Tick every section this entry should appear in. Sort entries with the Order number in the Attributes box.

description: Where the entry is listed on the React site.
